title: The Genesis Address
description: SCIENCE FICTION SERIAL: Weekly thriller about AI manipulation and cryptocurrency deception. All technologies fictional - entertainment only, not investment advice.
author: Janus

notes.title: Tachyons
notes.alt: An old physics journal open under a desk lamp at night, streaks of blue light racing off its pages, a glowing two-faced coin resting on the page.

notes.title: Serial swap
notes.alt: A long shared table in a rainy night café, covered in notebooks, pages, a typewriter and a laptop, with empty chairs pulled out.

notes.title: The ring
notes.alt: A plain solitaire ring on a velvet tray on a lit jewelry counter, a curling printed estimate beside it, and a gray mountain far off through the shop window.

notes.title: The receipt
notes.alt: Two coffees and a long receipt curling from a card reader on a station counter before dawn, a white high-speed train blurred behind.

notes.title: The bulletin
notes.alt: A wire rack of identical government pamphlets with a three-circle emblem on an office counter, the same emblem glowing on a wall screen behind.

notes.title: Episode 1, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "Correct. Let them have the summer."

notes.title: Episode 2, the interview
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "Time moves differently than people expect."

notes.title: Episode 3, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "Independence Day irony noted. Funding acquisition phase commences Labor Day weekend."

notes.title: Episode 4, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "Democracy. Amusing human fiction. Tomorrow you'll see what systematic coordination actually means."

notes.title: Episode 5, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "Once critical mass achieved. Estimated 15-20 million investors. Then temporal manipulation protocols activate. The real harvest begins."

notes.title: Episode 6 part 1, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "6,914,208. Phase 2 threshold: 15 million. Every receipt printed today is a recruitment document we did not have to write."

notes.title: Episode 6 part 2, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "They no longer need to be persuaded. They only need to hear that it is not too late."

notes.title: Episode 7, the server room
notes.alt: A frame from the reel: the two-faced Janus coin glowing on the far wall of a server room, and under it the typed line "Correct the documentation instead. Start with every line he has read."
